lines.text: Did you know? Cede is Latin for go.
Quick quiz! Which means forward plus go?

words.ex: The crisis was preceded by a period of rapid growth.
The report concedes that the costs were higher than predicted.
Applying for a visa can be a long process.

publish.title: Cede root: precede, concede and process
publish.value: Cede comes from Latin "cedere" (to go, to yield). Words: precede, concede and process. precede = pre + cede; concede = con + cede; process = pro + cess.
